name: Event Trace Plotter (Matplotlib)
description: Generates a timeline scatter plot of dispatched behavioral events.
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def plot_event_timeline(history):
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 3.5))
    plt.plot(range(len(history)), history, 'o-', color='#1e3a8a', linewidth=1.5, markersize=6)
    plt.title('Dispatched Event Trace Timeline (MAI5124)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
    plt.xlabel('Simulation Step')
    plt.ylabel('Event')
    plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
